leads.summary: Healthtech-1 builds clinical AI for NHS GP practices, automating eligibility checks, triage and appointment booking through its Bookable products.
leads.hook: Bookable Navigator has doctor-developed AI route patients to the right care 'every time', taking requests from forms, texts and phone calls.
leads.angle_reason: Bookable's AI routes free-text patient requests to structured outcomes, the same LLM-to-fixed-schema problem MedVault solves with its Gemini pipeline and safety rules.

leads.summary: Rally sells agentic user-research infrastructure: participant recruiting, scheduling, consent, incentives and recordings for product teams, with an agent and MCP access.
leads.hook: Rally's agent runs recruitment end to end, with consent, permissions and data governance enforced underneath it.
leads.angle_reason: Rally's consent, permissions and data-governance layer is the kind of per-user access control and privacy enforcement MedVault implements at the queryset level, and its agent is LLM-driven.

leads.summary: Adaptyv runs an automated protein lab that tests customers' designed proteins and returns clean experimental data for AI models, sold per protein through a platform and API.
leads.hook: Its $40M Series A (announced Aug 25, 2026) is to expand the Lausanne team and build out the automated lab.
leads.angle_reason: Adaptyv's AI-first data product with an API is the closest match to MedVault's API-backed LLM pipeline, though the core business is wet-lab automation.

leads.summary: Karat is a fintech offering business banking, credit and cards to small businesses and creators in the US, with banking provided by partner banks.
leads.hook: The site says Karat is a financial technology company, not a bank, with its accounts provided by Grasshopper Bank and First Internet Bank under separate licenses.
leads.angle_reason: Karat's business accounts need per-user data isolation and auth, which MedVault's JWT refresh-token rotation and queryset-level isolation cover.

leads.summary: Great Question sells a UX research platform covering participant recruiting, scheduling, surveys and an AI moderator, mainly for product and design teams.
leads.hook: Its AI moderator runs interviews your team can steer, and its findings cite every session.
leads.angle_reason: Great Question's AI moderator summarizes interviews into findings, the same pattern as MedVault's grounded AI explanations with rules on what the model may claim.

leads.summary: Soraban sells an AI tax workflow platform for accounting firms, covering client intake, workpaper prep, tax-software data entry and e-signature delivery.
leads.hook: Soraban says its AI builds review-ready workpapers tied back to source documents, with an auditable trail from worksheet to source.
leads.angle_reason: Soraban turns uploaded client documents into AI-prepared, cited output, which is what MedVault does with an uploaded lab report and a schema-bound explanation.

leads.summary: Seam sells a single developer API to control third-party smart locks, thermostats, sensors and cameras, for platforms and AI agents.
leads.hook: Seam's access-grant flow issues PIN codes and mobile keys and sends webhooks as access changes, all through one API across lock brands.
leads.angle_reason: Seam is a developer-facing API that unifies many device vendors behind one interface, like Canopy's single analyzer interface across 10 languages.

leads.summary: Solo helps consumers respond to debt lawsuits and settle debts with collectors, using an AI assistant and charging a settlement fee.
leads.hook: SoloSettle's calculator takes a sliding fee from 19% down to 5%, depending on how close the settlement comes to the face value of the debt.
leads.angle_reason: Solo's AI assistant answers legal and financial questions for consumers, and MedVault's pipeline has the no-diagnosis safety rules and tolerant parsing that kind of advice product needs.

leads.summary: testRigor sells a plain-English test automation tool for web, mobile, API and AI features, used by QA teams and developers.
leads.hook: testRigor says Claude Code can generate its tests through MCP and Skills, then use /goal to fix code until the tests pass.
leads.angle_reason: testRigor is a developer testing tool that plugs into Claude Code via MCP, in the same dev-tools and CI territory as Canopy's code analysis.

leads.summary: IOMETE sells a self-hosted data lakehouse platform that runs on premises or in customers' clouds, for analytics and ML on Apache Spark.
leads.hook: IOMETE's access controls go down to rows and columns, and the platform runs in the customer's own on-prem or cloud environment.
leads.angle_reason: IOMETE's row- and column-level access controls mirror the per-user isolation MedVault enforces at the queryset level, and its Python and SQL stack is closer to the candidate's than Spark is.
